cards.card_text: Then the tempter comes to Him and opens with a big fat IF: “If You are the Son of God…” Whoa, a voice from HEAVEN already said He is (Matthew 3:17)!
cards.verse_text: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”

cards.card_text: When Paul can't bear it any longer, he sends to find out about their faith, afraid the tempter had somehow tempted them.
cards.verse_text: For this reason, when I could bear it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith, for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and that our labor might have been in vain.
